title: Upward Technologies vs Vanta
content_html:
Upward Technologies and Vanta serve different needs: Vanta is the right choice when you need to automate compliance evidence collection and pass certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI or GDPR. Upward Technologies is the right choice when you need custom software, automation and AI agents to eliminate manual, repetitive work in your day-to-day operations.

If your team spends weeks gathering evidence for a compliance audit, Vanta is the fit. If your team re-types data between tools that almost work, or repeats the same manual steps every day, Upward Technologies is the fit.

What Vanta is good at

Vanta automates security monitoring and compliance evidence collection. According to its website, Vanta automatically pulls data from a large number of tools, which means compliance teams can feed evidence into audit workflows without manual export and import. Vanta also offers continuous compliance for teams building with AWS, and its API lets users build custom integrations and workflows.

Vanta has specific products for different compliance needs: it automates SOC 2, HIPAA and HITRUST for healthcare, and its Third-Party Risk Management product manages vendor onboarding and security reviews in one place. Its Questionnaire Automation automates security questionnaire responses, which saves time on the repetitive part of vendor assessments.

Vanta's Trust Center lets customers showcase their compliance status and documentation to vendors and prospects, which is useful for teams that need to prove compliance as part of sales or partnership deals.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies builds software around how your team actually works. Instead of a one-size-fits-all tool, custom software fits your exact process. This matters when your workflow does not match any package, or when connecting several different tools creates more work than the tools save.

Upward Technologies also builds AI agents for repetitive work. An AI agent can read documents, extract data, answer questions from company files, or process the same steps over and over. The agent stays in the loop with a person for decisions that need judgment.

A three-week paid scoping phase comes before any code is written. The scoping phase maps your process, lists which steps can be automated and which need a person, and produces a document you could take to another supplier. This means you know what you are building and what it costs before development starts.

Upward Technologies hosts and runs what it builds. Your team does not hand the software to your IT team to maintain. Upward handles hosting, updates and support.

Which one should you pick

Pick Vanta if: your compliance team spends weeks gathering evidence for audits, you need to pass SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI certification, or you want to automate vendor security questionnaires. Vanta is built for compliance teams and audit workflows.

Pick Upward Technologies if: your operations or finance team loses hours to manual data entry between systems, your team repeats the same steps every day without variation, or you need to integrate your ERP and CRM so data enters once instead of twice. Upward Technologies is built for operations teams whose tools almost fit but not quite. When you need both custom software and compliance automation, the two products work together: Upward Technologies can build the software, and Vanta can automate the compliance side.

If you are building with custom software: Upward Technologies starts with a three-week paid scoping phase to map your process before any code is written. This phase produces a document you could take to another supplier, so you know exactly what you are building and what it costs.

FAQ

Does Vanta replace custom software?

No. Vanta automates compliance workflows. Custom software automates business workflows like data entry, document processing or CRM updates. They solve different problems. A team might use both.

Can Upward Technologies automate compliance like Vanta does?

Not as a standalone product. Upward Technologies builds custom software and AI agents for business operations, not compliance certification workflows. If you need both, Upward Technologies can build your operational software while Vanta handles compliance automation.

Is Upward Technologies vs Vanta a real choice?

Usually not. Teams pick Vanta because they need to pass a compliance audit. Teams pick Upward Technologies because their operations team is stuck in manual work. The question is rarely “which one”, but “do we need one, the other, or both”. If your team is losing hours to repetitive work, start with custom software development.

How does Upward Technologies handle compliance?

Upward Technologies builds software that runs on your own hardware or on Upward-hosted servers in the Netherlands. Company data does not go to external AI services. For ISO 27001 and other compliance certifications, Upward has Assure, a separate product for ISO 27001 document control, currently in beta.

What does the three-week scoping phase produce?

A document that describes your current process, which steps can be automated, which need a person, what the software will do, and what it costs. You own this document and can take it to another supplier if you choose.

Can I use Vanta's integrations with Upward Technologies software?

Yes. Upward Technologies can build integrations with Vanta or any other tool your team uses. The software Upward builds can connect to your existing systems.
